{{Top}}
{{Quote|Who still plays smashball?|Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>}}
'''Smashball''' was a violent spectator sport that had a large interplanetary fandom in the years prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], at least in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TJP" /> Smashball was played with [[Smashball mallet|mallets]].<ref name="FP">{{GamerCite|1|Fair Prey}}</ref>

[[Raal Yorta]] claimed to have won several smashball trophies in his past.
